notes.title: SRJJ 1.20 Hats!
notes.content:
Well hats have actually been in the game since launch people didn't really know much about them so this update has put them front and center on the main menu and made hat selection your choice.

Over the next few days the remaining hats will filter in and a few blanks will be left for future updates. Expect to feel well rewarded for hunting down all those Speed stars and cogs.

- Hats menu added to game
- New hats added to game
- More new hats coming tomorrow (No update will be posted for that patch)
